messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — PR #4826 (migration guide v0.9→v1.0) needs a docs + SDK snippet review. CI preview is flaking on linkcheck, so snapshot isn't posting.
Maria: I can take docs content review. @Jon can you check SDK snippet? Also, is this OK to merge during next docs merge window?
Jon: I can do the snippet review tomorrow morning. The preview flake looks like the relative link linter: "broken link to ../sdk/python.md" — seen that before.
DocBot: preview-build failed for PR #4826 — error: LinkCheckerError: Found 1 broken link in /docs/migration/upgrade.md line 42
Paul: Quick workaround: change the link to absolute /docs/sdk/python or add the anchor. But let's fix the source so later previews pass.
Maria: I'll push a tiny patch to update the path and tidy up wording. Will tag @Alex when ready.
Emily: FYI, docs merge window today 4–5pm PT. If reviewers finish before 3:30pm we can include in the batch. Otherwise queue for tomorrow.
Alex: Sounds good. @Jon please review snippet by 10am PT so Maria can finalize. @Paul can you sanity-check the preview build after Maria's patch?
Paul: Yep, I'll re-run linkcheck: `./scripts/run-linkcheck.sh --path docs/migration/upgrade.md` and report back.
Maria: Pushed fix in branch `fix/upgrade-links-4826`. CI retriggered.
DocBot: preview-build started for PR #4826 — run id: 8201
DocBot: preview-build succeeded for PR #4826 — no link errors detected. :tada:
Jon: Reviewed snippet, left one small nit about named params. LGTM after that.
Maria: Addressed nit, updated snippet and added a one-line example. Ping @Alex for merge.
Alex: Thanks all. Merging into next docs batch. Note: adding this PR to rotation checklist so future migration guides include an SDK snippet reviewer by default. :white_check_mark:
